entities.summary: Jaccob Scott Slavin is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman and alternate captain for the Carolina Hurricanes of the National Hockey League (NHL). Slavin was selected by the Hurricanes in the fourth round, 120th overall, of the 2012 NHL entry draft.
